notes.title: DETECTIVE – The Test is OUT NOW on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]The latest entry in the DETECTIVE series is here! 🕵️‍♂️
[/h2]

Put your deduction skills to the ultimate test in DETECTIVE – The Test, now available on Steam!

Step into the mind of a real detective and investigate three unique crime scenes:
🏠 A mysterious home
🚐 A secluded caravan park
☕ A coffee shop hiding dark secrets

There are no hints, no hand-holding, just you, your intuition, and your logic. Are you ready to connect the dots and uncover the truth?

🎮 Get it now and start solving mysteries like never before:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473570?utm_source=event
